sentences: The loop swaps every pair that is out of order, so one pass puts everything in order.
Since it checks each neighbouring pair from start to end, the biggest number moves right and arranges all.
After going through j equals zero to two, all the comparisons fix the whole array.
Every time a smaller number is found before a bigger one, they swap, making the list sorted.
The for loop runs over the array once and each swap corrects the order completely.
